notes: Your AniList list now shows up where you would look for it. Home has a Watching on AniList row, because signing in and then finding none of your own anime anywhere on the page is the reason it exists; it keeps its own copy of the list rather than sharing the library screen's, which changes status every time a tab is clicked. The library also opens on Watching when you are signed in, instead of on Continue watching, which only lists episodes played on this machine and so left someone who had just signed in on an empty page.
